text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you not taking a detour 
today?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Remember how we listened to classical 
music at that cafe and shared our thoughts 
on it before?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, we really got to relax together!

...Yeah, it was nice relaxing together, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I believe that sharing our impressions and 
communicating will lead to more efficient 
training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Introducing the things you like is the 
first step," the guidebook also said.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...So, let's take another detour today. 
Starting with your favorite things."

Taking the suggestion to heart, I thought 
carefully about what the two of us would 
want to share.

If we're to have fun together, something 
sports-related. Still, I should make sure 
she doesn't tire herself out...

text_block_list.name: Deeply Moved Director
text_block_list.text:
"‘You did it! Look, it's the trophy you've 
always dreamed of... The number one in 
Japan!!’"

text_block_list.name: Crying Competitor
text_block_list.text:
"Uuu... It's just so dazzling, I can't 
help it...! Because this trophy... is what 
we won together!"

“Guts Smash! 3 Tears-Filled Years”. I 
watched the sports anime movie famous for 
making people cry.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ... ...Trainer, do you need a tissue?
choice_data_list:
Sorry! I'm really bad with stuff like 
that...!

text_block_list.text:
I wipe away a faint tear. To achieve an 
athlete's dream together. Seeing that 
simply overwhelmed me with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Next, it is my turn to introduce 
something I am fond of."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's head for the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This is the mountain I use for solo 
training. It's very effective for 
full-body aerobic exercise.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The ups and downs along the way are also 
perfect for building lower-body strength.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: After that...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The view from the summit is wonderful too. 
Come, let us go.

And so, with Duramente as our guide, our 
climb up her favorite mountain began!
(Pheeew...)

The wind blowing through is cold and 
piercing. The altitude feels quite high as 
well. It is undoubtedly an advanced 
mountain climbing course, but--

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer, over here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There are some stones around here that are 
easy to sit on. You should rest for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I usually don't walk, but... there is a 
route with a gentler slope ahead. After 
resting a bit, let us head that way."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Even on this path, our destination is the 
same. Can you still walk?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let's go... the two of us, to the summit.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...We made it. The summit.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...What a nice breeze.

It opened up into a spacious hill. Below, 
bathed in sunlight, the sparkling city 
stretched outâa truly breathtaking view.
choice_data_list:
Amazing! So this is the kind of view you 
always see.

Amazing! So this is the kind of view you 
always see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"That may be true, but... It looks even 
more dazzling than usual. ...Could this 
be—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ... 'A trophy... won by the two of us.'

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's quite nice, isn't it? ...Both that 
movie, and climbing a mountain together.
choice_data_list: It feels like a waste to get off now.

It'd be a shame to get off now, wouldn't 
it?

Climbing all the way up was totally worth 
the effort!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's quite nice, isn't it? ...Both that 
movie, and climbing a mountain together.
choice_data_list: It feels like a waste to get off now.

It'd be a shame to get off now, wouldn't 
it?

Climbing all the way up was totally worth 
the effort!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll pass. Training awaits tomorrow as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'd like to find another chance 
to go out again.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you must be tired. I'll carry you on 
my back on the way home.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I still have plenty of stamina left. 
Besides, I know this mountain well. Don't 
be shy, hop onto my back.

I quickly assured them that a little rest 
would fix me right up, and we made our way 
down the mountain, taking breaks along the 
way.
